## Change

Describe the problem and the smallest change that resolves it.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant Playwright scenario, when browser behavior changed
- [ ] Public-source and release boundaries still pass

## Public-data check

- [ ] No private or third-party documents, personal data, credentials, private paths, or internal host identifiers were added.
- [ ] Documentation states the host application's storage, authentication, authorization, validation, and maintenance responsibilities accurately.
- [ ] This change does not promise individual support, an SLA, LTS, response time, compatibility, or commercial service.
